principle_violations.reason: The Order class handles both item storage and state management, and the PaymentProcessor directly modifies the order status. These violate single responsibility as the logic should be segregated.
principle_violations.suggestion: Decouple payment operations into a specialized class and have Order focus only on managing items and state separately.

principle_violations.reason: Directly setting the status within PaymentProcessor tightly couples it to the Order class. Adding new payment methods would require modifying the PaymentProcessor class.
principle_violations.suggestion: Use an interface or strategy pattern to define payment methods for extensibility.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details above.
